name: Chat thread
purpose: Written messages arriving in a chat (team channel or phone), read out by the narrator, to show or examine an exchange.
use_when: the source quotes chat, Slack, Teams or text messages
showing how a written message lands, or how a thread went wrong or right
avoid_when: a spoken conversation to act out in two voices (use dialogue)
a single email or screen to annotate (use annotated_mock)

channel.desc: Channel or contact name, e.g. '#launch-team' or 'Priya'

me.desc: true for the viewer's own messages

app.desc: A team-chat window: avatars, names, messages in a column

phone.desc: A phone conversation: bubbles, yours on the other side, typing dots before replies

messages.text: Can someone check the pricing page before 3?
On it. Two prices don't match the plan sheet.
Thanks for catching that! Which ones?
Team and Business. Fixing both now.

example.note: Short, specific replies keep a thread moving.

example_beats.say: Priya asks for a check before three.
Theo replies with exactly what he found.
and he names them and says what he's doing about it.
Short, specific replies keep a thread moving.
